{{Quote|No doubt you recognized the pale squirmers who greeted you.|Rur to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="BF!" />}}
The '''Rozzum''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] who came from another dimension than that of the [[Universe/Legends|known universe]]. They had ties to the [[Order of the Terrible Glare/Legends|Order of the Terrible Glare]], a group of dissident [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] formed during the [[Pius Dea Crusades]]. In ancient [[Time/Legends|times]], several Rozzum were stranded on [[PL-40112-CE-021105]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Some time later, during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] reign, Imperial surveyors encountered that group of Rozzum after having inadvertently awakened them. The Imperials allied with the local people to fight the monsters off, which left only two survivors. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the young [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Mission to Garn|encountered]] Rozzum on [[Garn/Legends|Garn]], where he had been lured by [[Rur/Legends|Rur]], the last [[High Shaman of the Terrible Glare]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Rozzum were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="KotORCG" /> the members of which could take a wide array of forms. Some had [[Bat/Legends|bat]]-like wings, others looked like multi-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Octopus/Legends|octopuses]]. Still others resembled [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] or giant [[Insect/Legends|insects]]. They moved by skittering and fluttering around on the floor. They had the uncanny ability to invade another being's mind through the [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], with the consequence of instilling a fearful nausea into them.<ref name="BF!" />

==Society and culture==
While they appeared as monstrous beasts, the Rozzum did possess a [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Rozzum (language)|their own]],<ref name="KotORCG" /> a trait associated with the ability to reason and understand abstract concepts.<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> Non-Rozzum have been able to speak that language fluently, as easily as any of the more common tongues such as [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] or [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="KotORCG" />

==History==
The Rozzum evolved in a dimension separate from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Realspace/Legends|own]].<ref name="Barely Tolerable 1" />

At some point in history, they became connected with the [[Order of the Terrible Glare/Legends|Order of the Terrible Glare]],<ref name="Barely Tolerable 1" /> a splinter group of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] formed when the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] withdrew to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Pius Dea Crusades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In ancient [[Time/Legends|times]], one group of Rozzum crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[PL-40112-CE-021105]] in the [[Salfrem system]] within [[the Wastes]] region of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Many a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] later, under the reign of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], surveyors from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] set foot on PL-40112-CE-021105, where they inadvertently awakened the long-lost Rozzum from their slumber. Both the [[near-Human]]s living on the planet and the Imperials were forced to work together to drive them off, an action that only left two survivors: the [[Human/Legends|Human]]-[[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] [[Bertroff Hissa]] and Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]].<ref name="Barely Tolerable 1" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was [[Mission to Garn|lured]] to the planet [[Garn/Legends|Garn]] by [[Rur/Legends|Rur]], [[High Shaman of the Terrible Glare]] and last member of his order. When Skywalker entered Rur's lair, he was assaulted by a group of Rozzum who squirmed out of the dark. The Rozzum induced unspeakable horror in Skywalker's mind, but they ended up leaving him alone so he could meet Rur.<ref name="BF!" />

==Rozzum in the galaxy==
Typically, the [[Jedi Shadow]]s, who devoted themselves to destroying everything connected with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], were taught to speak the Rozzum language among their many unusual skills.<ref name="KotORCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|For clarity, the 'phantasmagoric' Rozzum are the medley of medieval-art-like monsters Luke encounters in his waking dream in 'Blind Fury' (i.e. the pig lovin' on Luke, et al).|Abel G. Peña|<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50951421|board=Literature|thread=Finally, Aliens in the Empire Part 3? Handley and Peña are on a Roll!|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-08-26|time=12:06 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304014148/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/finally-aliens-in-the-empire-part-3-handley-and-pe%C3%B1a-are-on-a-roll.50014285/page-6}}</ref>}}
The Rozzum were created by [[Abel G. Peña]], who first mentioned them through their language in the [[2008]] sourcebook ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''. In [[2013]], Peña first described the Rozzum as inter-dimensional monsters in part 1 of ''[[Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire]]'', a series of reference articles on the [[StarWars.com]] blogs. He explicitly pointed out the connection between the two sources on the [[Jedi Council Forums]]. In the same post, Peña hinted that the Rozzum may be related to [[Waru]] and the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]], other inter-dimensional beings who appeared in the earlier [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]. He also implied that ''[[Cult Encounters of the Star Wars Universe]]'', an unpublished article written by [[Joseph Bongiorno]] and [[Rich Handley]], would address the aforementioned aliens.<ref name="JCF2">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50933998|board=Literature|thread=Finally, Aliens in the Empire Part 3? Handley and Peña are on a Roll!|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-08-18|time=10:21 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802144408/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/finally-aliens-in-the-empire-part-3-handley-and-pe%C3%B1a-are-on-a-roll.50014285/page-4}}</ref> Later, Peña revealed that the Rozzum were in fact the monsters Luke Skywalker encountered in ''[[Blind Fury!]]'', a [[1982]] ''Star Wars'' comic story written by [[Alan Moore]].<ref name="JCF" />
